convert_checkpoint_to_hf: convert OneFormer checkpoints from the original SHI Labs repository to HuggingFace transformers format
test_model_conversion: test the converted OneFormer model matches the original model outputs within tolerance
setup_oneformer_config: setup OneFormer configuration from a YAML config file using detectron2 config system
build_processor_from_config: build a OneFormerProcessor with image processor and CLIPTokenizer from original config
post_process_segmentation: post process OneFormer segmentation output by interpolating masks and computing softmax probabilities
